content.user_title: Restore Refactoring Context Across AI Sessions
content.value_statement: Long refactors lose important decisions when work moves across sessions or agents. This skill guides semantic context retrieval, ranking, rehydration, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Defines inputs for context source, project identifier, restoration mode, token budget, and relevance threshold.
Explains semantic vector search, relevance filtering, and ranking for restored project context.
Outlines rehydration patterns that prioritize project overview, decisions, stack, recent work, and known issues.
Provides workflows for project resumption and cross-project knowledge transfer.
Covers conflict resolution, integrity checks, caching, and integration with RAG pipelines.
limitations: It provides guidance and pseudocode, not a packaged executable tool.
It does not include a real vector database, embedding model, or storage adapter.
Users must supply the context source, project namespace, and current project state.
The scanned package only includes SKILL.md, so referenced resource details may be unavailable.

use_cases.title: Resume a long refactor
use_cases.description: Restore decisions, recent work, known issues, and architecture notes before continuing a complex code change.

use_cases.title: Coordinate agent handoffs
use_cases.description: Prepare ranked context for another AI agent so it can continue work with less repeated discovery.

use_cases.title: Transfer project knowledge
use_cases.description: Map relevant context from one project to another while checking fit, provenance, and conflicts.

prompt_templates.title: Restore Project Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for resuming work after a pause.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to restore context for my current project. Identify the needed inputs, choose a restoration mode, and produce a resumption summary.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Incremental Loading
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for large projects with token limits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an incremental context loading plan for this refactor. Rank context components, set a token budget, and list validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Context Versions
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for conflicting session histories.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare two context histories for this project. Identify conflicts, propose a merge strategy, and preserve decision provenance.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Retrieval Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for teams building a context restoration system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a semantic context restoration workflow for multi-agent refactoring. Include retrieval, ranking, rehydration, integrity checks, and performance considerations.

output_examples.input: Resume a web platform refactor after several interrupted sessions.
output: Priority context: architecture decisions, recent agent work, technology stack, and known issues.
Verification: compare restored assumptions against the current codebase before editing.

output_examples.input: Prepare context for a new agent joining a machine learning pipeline project.
output: The skill would rank model training strategy, data pipeline decisions, open issues, and recent changes.
It would produce a compact handoff summary with provenance and unresolved conflicts.

output_examples.input: Move lessons from one refactor into a related service migration.
output_examples.output: The skill would map transferable decisions, flag assumptions that need validation, and recommend a context merge plan.

best_practices: Validate restored context against the current codebase before acting on it.
Set the token budget and relevance threshold before retrieval begins.
Preserve provenance for decisions, conflicts, and transferred knowledge.
anti_patterns: Restoring every stored memory without ranking relevance.
Treating stale context as authoritative without validation.
Merging context versions without resolving semantic conflicts.

faq.question: What does this skill help restore?
faq.answer: It helps restore project context such as decisions, architecture notes, technology stack details, recent work, and known issues.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill is Markdown guidance with pseudocode and usage examples. It does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs should I prepare?
faq.answer: Prepare a context source, project identifier, restoration mode, token budget, relevance threshold, and current project state.

faq.question: Does it replace a RAG system?
faq.answer: No. It describes retrieval and rehydration patterns that can work with a RAG or vector search system.

faq.question: How should large projects use it?
faq.answer: Use incremental loading, rank context by relevance, and validate each restored component before relying on it.
